mechanism_narrative: A negative change in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month (indicating a rate cut) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is always active and does not require a threshold condition for activation; the direction is fixed by the sign of the change (negative change = positive returns).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month (i.e., change < 0), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 225 signals inflationary pressure that leads to central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 225, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8.5% and employment growth (PAYEMS change) is negative, it signals a recessionary labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.5 AND PAYEMS change < 0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), a rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is active only when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, and the direction is fixed by the sign of INDPRO change (positive change = positive returns).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5% AND INDPRO change > 0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90, it signals a supply shock that increases uncertainty and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90 and the demand for financial services (RSAFS) falls below 390000, it signals a severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90 AND RSAFS < 390000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (as indicated by GDP growth above 2% and unemployment below 5%), a rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is active only during late-cycle expansions, and the direction is fixed by the sign of HOUST change (positive change = positive returns).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 3mo growth > 2% AND UNRATE < 5% AND HOUST change > 0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600, it signals weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 600, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.
